# Retained licensing and attribution

`SuccessorTree/` retains the CC0 1.0 Universal legal text supplied by the
upstream snapshot, copied byte for byte as `LICENSE.SuccessorTree`.
Its original source repository and revision are recorded in
`provenance/UPSTREAM.json`.

`CCO/` and `PartiteConstruction/` are reproduced unchanged from the pinned
`shulda/lean_cco` snapshot. No additional standalone license file for these
paths is present in that snapshot. Their source identities, original per-file
notices, and upstream provenance are preserved; this file asserts no new
license grant for them.
